mapper.update: UPDATE GROUPS /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.groups.updateGroups */ SET GRP_ID = #{grpId} , GRP_NAME = #{grpName} , DESCRIPTION = #{description} WHERE GRP_ID = #{grpId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM GROUPS /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.groups.deleteGroups */ WHERE GRP_ID = #{grpId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.groups.selectGroups */ GRP_ID as grpId, GRP_NAME as grpName, DESCRIPTION as description FROM GROUPS WHERE GRP_ID = #{grpId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.groups.selectListGroups */ GRP_ID as grpId, GRP_NAME as grpName, DESCRIPTION as description FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM GROUPS WHERE 1=1
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.groups.selectListCountGroups */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM GROUPS WHERE 1=1
